description: EncryptLock is an independent Layer-1 blockchain built with Cosmos SDK and CometBFT, live since 18 October 2026. It is run by LockKeepers: ordinary Windows computers that run the blockchain, create the blocks and earn LOCK; each proves it is a real, separate computer with its TPM 2.0 chip (one computer, one vote). Every account signs every transaction with Ed25519 and ML-DSA-65 (NIST post-quantum, FIPS 204), and consensus votes use ML-DSA-65. Transfers must be accepted by the receiver within 1 hour or they return by themselves, and the chain has a freeze button, second-device approval, daily limits, a Sovereign Vault with 7 to 365 day withdrawal delays, inheritance and recovery by trusted people. Its built-in order-book market trades LOCK for USDC on Polygon through atomic swaps. Fees are a percentage of the amount (0.1% for transfers, 0.25% on the market), not gas prices. Maximum supply: 40,000,000 LOCK.
